name: Hover trim
description: Climbs to target_alt and holds it on the barometer; an integrator learns the hover throttle. Without a position source it holds its place from the accelerometer: it levels the reading on the ground, then turns the drag it feels into a velocity and leans against the drift.
description_zh: 爬升到 target_alt 并依据气压高度保持；积分项学习悬停油门。没有定位源时依据加速度计保持位置：先在地面校准读数，再把感受到的空气阻力换算为速度，以小角度倾斜抵消漂移。
